content: Narration:

raw: The Messenger's day begins before sunrise, at the hour when starlight begins to give way to dawn.
content: The Messenger's day begins before sunrise, at the hour when starlight begins to give way to dawn.

raw: In remote regions like this, the delivery of parcels, letters, even simple messages, requires no ordinary effort.
content: In remote regions like this, the delivery of parcels, letters, even simple messages, requires no ordinary effort.

raw: Messengers embark on long journeys into the wilds, facing a multitude of risks and challenges. This Messenger, for instance, walks a dozen li every day—
content: Messengers embark on long journeys into the wilds, facing a multitude of risks and challenges. This Messenger, for instance, walks a dozen li every day—

speaker: Messenger
content: Dozens of li.

raw: [name="Messenger"]A dozen li won't even get me over a single peak.
speaker: Messenger
content: A dozen li won't even get me over a single peak.

raw: Sorry, my mistake. I'll redo the narration...
content: Sorry, my mistake. I'll redo the narration...

raw: [name="Messenger"]You still good? Need help with your backpack?
speaker: Messenger
content: You still good? Need help with your backpack?
N-No...
I-I can handle it...

raw: [name="Messenger"]We only reached one village today. That's a lot slower than normal.
speaker: Messenger
content: We only reached one village today. That's a lot slower than normal.

raw: I'm sorry... I'll do my best to keep up.
content: I'm sorry... I'll do my best to keep up.

speaker: Messenger
content: Just take it easy.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Let's take a break. It would only be more trouble if you collapsed. You're not exactly an athlete, by the looks of it.
speaker: Messenger
content: Let's take a break. It would only be more trouble if you collapsed. You're not exactly an athlete, by the looks of it.

speaker: Messenger
content: Have some water.

raw: [name="Messenger"]And tie this bandage around your ankle, or by tomorrow it'll be swollen, and you can't even walk.
speaker: Messenger
content: And tie this bandage around your ankle, or by tomorrow it'll be swollen, and you can't even walk.
T-Thank you...

raw: Sorry about this... I didn't mean to be a burden.
content: Sorry about this... I didn't mean to be a burden.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Hah. Not like I ever expected a city boy to keep up with me.
speaker: Messenger
content: Hah. Not like I ever expected a city boy to keep up with me.

raw: [name="Messenger"]What exactly have you been filming, anyway?
speaker: Messenger
content: What exactly have you been filming, anyway?

raw: Just the scenes and people along the way...
content: Just the scenes and people along the way...

raw: [name="Messenger"]I've seen movies too, seen the glamorous scenes, handsome actors, and beautiful actresses...
speaker: Messenger
content: I've seen movies too, seen the glamorous scenes, handsome actors, and beautiful actresses...

raw: [name="Messenger"]Is there a reason you're filming bare mountains like these?
speaker: Messenger
content: Is there a reason you're filming bare mountains like these?
Of course there is!

raw: True beauty lies in that which is authentic. Glamorous, whitewashed scenes are no more than a deception.
content: True beauty lies in that which is authentic. Glamorous, whitewashed scenes are no more than a deception.

raw: There's meaning in filming that which no one has ever seen and that which has become lost to the passage of time, so that more people can see them.
content: There's meaning in filming that which no one has ever seen and that which has become lost to the passage of time, so that more people can see them.

speaker: Messenger
content: Hm...

raw: Since we're taking a break, may I interview you?
content: Since we're taking a break, may I interview you?

speaker: Messenger
content: Inter... view?

raw: Just asking some questions. You don't have to answer, if you don't want to.
content: Just asking some questions. You don't have to answer, if you don't want to.

raw: [name="Messenger"]I guess... do I talk into the camera?
speaker: Messenger
content: I guess... do I talk into the camera?

raw: Have you always lived in these mountains?
content: Have you always lived in these mountains?

raw: [name="Messenger"]I left for a few years to go to school, and came back after graduating.
speaker: Messenger
content: I left for a few years to go to school, and came back after graduating.

raw: Could you talk about this place from your own perspective?
content: Could you talk about this place from your own perspective?

speaker: Messenger
content: Er... talk about it?

raw: [name="Messenger"]It's just what you're looking at... ordinary mountains, far away from civilization. Not a lot of people here, and even fewer visitors.
speaker: Messenger
content: It's just what you're looking at... ordinary mountains, far away from civilization. Not a lot of people here, and even fewer visitors.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Nothing's really changed as far as I can remember... other than the building of the Chidao.
speaker: Messenger
content: Nothing's really changed as far as I can remember... other than the building of the Chidao.

raw: How do the people here make a living?
content: How do the people here make a living?

raw: [name="Messenger"]Most years, we grow enough to feed ourselves, and trade any surplus we have for other things we need.
speaker: Messenger
content: Most years, we grow enough to feed ourselves, and trade any surplus we have for other things we need.

raw: [name="Messenger"]The climate may be dry, but it's just right for certain fruits.
speaker: Messenger
content: The climate may be dry, but it's just right for certain fruits.

raw: [name="Messenger"]A while back, I was thinking whether there was a way to sell the fruit grown in the village to the cities.
speaker: Messenger
content: A while back, I was thinking whether there was a way to sell the fruit grown in the village to the cities.

raw: [name="Messenger"]But the cost of transportation was too high, so nothing came of it.
speaker: Messenger
content: But the cost of transportation was too high, so nothing came of it.

raw: A lot of the villages look pretty empty.
content: A lot of the villages look pretty empty.

raw: [name="Messenger"]People had been moving to the nomadic cities for years. The young people went first. Now, even the children and elderly are following.
speaker: Messenger
content: People had been moving to the nomadic cities for years. The young people went first. Now, even the children and elderly are following.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Not much has changed here, but the cities expand quickly. There are more jobs there.
speaker: Messenger
content: Not much has changed here, but the cities expand quickly. There are more jobs there.

raw: [name="Messenger"]I'm the only one left in the village where I grew up.
speaker: Messenger
content: I'm the only one left in the village where I grew up.

raw: They went to the cities? Why did you stay here?
content: They went to the cities? Why did you stay here?

speaker: Messenger
content: I'm Infected, after all.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Maybe I could have gone if I really wanted to, but I took a look at myself in the mirror, and traversing these mountains is what I do best.
speaker: Messenger
content: Maybe I could have gone if I really wanted to, but I took a look at myself in the mirror, and traversing these mountains is what I do best.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Rather than start from scratch in an unfamiliar place, I would rather do what I can, especially if this helps other people.
speaker: Messenger
content: Rather than start from scratch in an unfamiliar place, I would rather do what I can, especially if this helps other people.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Plus, who would deliver the mail if I left?
speaker: Messenger
content: Plus, who would deliver the mail if I left?
Isn't it tough?

raw: Have you ever thought it was unfair?
content: Have you ever thought it was unfair?

speaker: Messenger
content: Tough?

raw: [name="Messenger"]Is there anything that isn't tough? I'm more comfortable doing what I'm good at, what I'm familiar with.
speaker: Messenger
content: Is there anything that isn't tough? I'm more comfortable doing what I'm good at, what I'm familiar with.

raw: [name="Messenger"]As far as fair or unfair... who's to judge that sort of stuff? I would rather just do my job.
speaker: Messenger
content: As far as fair or unfair... who's to judge that sort of stuff? I would rather just do my job.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Or did you think that life outside the cities was hell?
speaker: Messenger
content: Or did you think that life outside the cities was hell?

raw: [name="Messenger"]Things might be monotonous here, but it's not so bad that we have to beg for sympathy.
speaker: Messenger
content: Things might be monotonous here, but it's not so bad that we have to beg for sympathy.

raw: [name="Messenger"]There's nothing wrong with working hard and making a simple, grounded living.
speaker: Messenger
content: There's nothing wrong with working hard and making a simple, grounded living.
I guess you're right...

raw: But how could there be change, if things continue like this?
content: But how could there be change, if things continue like this?

speaker: Messenger
content: Change?

speaker: Messenger
content: Things are changing every day.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Today's house is a little more solid than yesterday, and today's crops grow a little taller.
speaker: Messenger
content: Today's house is a little more solid than yesterday, and today's crops grow a little taller.

raw: That's not the kind of change I'm talking about!
content: That's not the kind of change I'm talking about!

raw: I'm talking about change on a larger scale, on a structural level...
content: I'm talking about change on a larger scale, on a structural level...

raw: People shouldn't be limited by what they were born into... they should have equal access to resources and opportunities no matter where they live.
content: People shouldn't be limited by what they were born into... they should have equal access to resources and opportunities no matter where they live.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Sure, that's a nice thought to have... but you've got to start with solid, hard work, after all.
speaker: Messenger
content: Sure, that's a nice thought to have... but you've got to start with solid, hard work, after all.

raw: [name="Messenger"]Let's give this a rest, we've gone way off topic.
speaker: Messenger
content: Let's give this a rest, we've gone way off topic.

raw: Alright, we can about something else. What about yourself?
content: Alright, we can about something else. What about yourself?

raw: [name="Messenger"]Myself? What is there to talk about it?
speaker: Messenger
content: Myself? What is there to talk about it?

raw: As a Messenger, what sort of regrets do you have? What are your hopes of the future? What's been the most unforgettable thing in your career?
content: As a Messenger, what sort of regrets do you have? What are your hopes of the future? What's been the most unforgettable thing in your career?

speaker: Messenger
content: Unforgettable thing...?

raw: [name="Messenger"]I'll tell you, but only if you turn off the camera.
speaker: Messenger
content: I'll tell you, but only if you turn off the camera.
Sure!

raw: [name="Messenger"]There was one time when I was hurrying through the mountains overnight to make an urgent delivery.
speaker: Messenger
content: There was one time when I was hurrying through the mountains overnight to make an urgent delivery.

raw: [name="Messenger"]It was raining, and the dirt on the slopes started to come lose. Rocks came rolling down the slope...
speaker: Messenger
content: It was raining, and the dirt on the slopes started to come lose. Rocks came rolling down the slope...
Was your infection—

speaker: Messenger
content: No, no.

raw: [name="Messenger"]I saw a big rock that was about to fall onto the parcels. I don't know what I was thinking in the heat of the moment, so I tried to knock it away with my horns...
speaker: Messenger
content: I saw a big rock that was about to fall onto the parcels. I don't know what I was thinking in the heat of the moment, so I tried to knock it away with my horns...

raw: [name="Messenger"]That's how I broke my left horn.
speaker: Messenger
content: That's how I broke my left horn.
Pffft––

speaker: Messenger
content: Are you laughing?
S-Sorry, I didn't mean to—

raw: [name="Messenger"]Whatever. Still better than the long look on your face you've been having.
speaker: Messenger
content: Whatever. Still better than the long look on your face you've been having.

raw: [name="Messenger"]I find it funny too. I still carry the broken horn with me, to remind myself not to rush on rainy nights.
speaker: Messenger
content: I find it funny too. I still carry the broken horn with me, to remind myself not to rush on rainy nights.

raw: [name="Messenger"]And maybe I could find a doctor to put it back, if I get the chance.
speaker: Messenger
content: And maybe I could find a doctor to put it back, if I get the chance.

raw: [name="Messenger"]I've done a lot of dumb things and seen a lot of interesting sights on my deliveries.
speaker: Messenger
content: I've done a lot of dumb things and seen a lot of interesting sights on my deliveries.

raw: [name="Messenger"]But I'm usually by myself, and there's no one to tell my stories to.
speaker: Messenger
content: But I'm usually by myself, and there's no one to tell my stories to.

raw: Well, here's your chance. Any other stories you care to tell?
content: Well, here's your chance. Any other stories you care to tell?

raw: And have you ever thought that you're not really by yourself when you're delivering?
content: And have you ever thought that you're not really by yourself when you're delivering?
